description: Grid-connected industrial site: 120 MW wind, 80 MW PV, 60 MW electrolyser, H₂ storage, an extendable fuel cell and a site battery, 40 MW critical process load and 25 MW H₂ offtake. Tagged for an Energy Hub study.

ledger.note: the campus run's island checks and the report's islanding chapter read it
ledger.value: seamless: the batteries form the island and carry the 40 MW process load; no genset, no UPS

ledger.note: demo values copied from the data center and gridspine, not from a datasheet or a grid code
ledger.value: batteries: the data center's bess_new block (droop 4 %, tau_f 0.1 s, i_max 1.2 pu, k_gfm_min 1.0, pf 0.95); fuel cell, wind and PV: gridspine's drafted grid-following default (Q(U), pf 0.95); the data center's frequency limits; sustained 1 h, bridge 600 s

ledger.note: the plan is not sized to island; turn them on to plan for islanding. Measured on this template (live solves, 2026-10-15): the solve's objective goes from 7.0 M to 8.8 M EUR at 1 h sustained (26 MW of new battery), 11.4 M at 4 h (42 MW) and 28.9 M at 24 h (170 MW), and the grid import falls from about 93 MW to 2-10 MW (owner: island data on, rows off, the user opts in)
